game.name: Grand Theft Auto - San Andreas (USA)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: GTA: San Andreas is an Xbox 360 Games on Demand action game in which you play as Carl Johnson, a small-time thug who has returned to his hometown. You discover that the hard law of gangs reigns and you have to create a name and reputation for yourself to gain respect. The game area is huge and consists of three large cities to complete missions. Murder, corruption, theft, betrayal... Find your place in Los Santos! This version supports 720p resolution.
game.genre: Shooter, Racing, Driving, Adventure / RealTime 3D, Adventure
